model.title: Market stability reserve for the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS): ceasing the invalidation of allowances

summary.text: The proposal aims to stop the automatic cancellation of emissions allowances under the EU's carbon trading scheme. This would allow more allowances to remain in circulation within the market stability reserve system.
